framework.cell: tetragonal polymorph-A cell, 192 atoms, 12.64 x 12.64 x 26.66 A

gm: planar Au7 (centred hexagon) spanning the 12-ring channel intersection (COM 0.25 A off-centre), monodentate Au-O >= 2.22 A, Au-Si >= 2.65 A (6 contacts < 3.0 A); binding to the frozen framework -1.9 eV
notes: Pilot: 10 seeds x BH/RS, 40k steps (campaign pilot-bze1-v2). Size scan (BH/RS ERT): Au6 2.1k/12.8k too easy, Au8 121k/never (RS 0/10) too hard, Au7 chosen. 15/20 runs reached the GM (energy spread 3.2 meV), no competing minimum within 0.08 eV. Budget = 3 x median BH hit (4.0k) = 12k steps (~2.5 min/run). Short Au-Si contacts (2.65 A, ~1.07 x covalent sum) are an NEP89 feature; NEP89 is not fitted to metal/zeolite interfaces, cluster-framework binding is qualitative.
